map.适合单进程、低并发、嵌入式的场景：本地应用缓存、移动端存储、测试与数据分析。它的: It suits single-process, low-concurrency, embedded scenarios: local app caches, mobile storage, testing, and data analysis. Its dynamic typing and weak constraints make development fast, but also mean no strict type checking. It is not for high-concurrency writes—a write locks the whole database file, and parallel writes from multiple processes easily conflict.
